item.title: Tests on 8 frozen Inca mummies sacrificed show they had chewed coca leaves and had drunk alcohol
item.description: A remarkable archaeological find has revealed eight frozen mummies of children from the Inca Empire, believed to have been sacrificed. Analysis of their hair and nails showed they've ingested coca and alcohol, hinting at a diversity of ritual practices based on local customs. Notably, one mummy, Juanita, contained harmine traces, suggesting specialized ritualistic preparations. This research unveils a rich tapestry of ancient cultural traditions and ceremonies. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Muere Gonzalo Moratorio, el científico que "blindó" a Uruguay del covid-19 y luchaba por pagarse un costoso tratamiento contra el cáncer
item.description: Falleció a los 44 años después de padecer un glioblastoma, un tumor cerebral agresivo. Fuente: BBC News Mundo.

item.title: 31 mil reproducciones · 91 reacciones | Itchy skin? Burning eyes? Sleepless nights? Awkward spots? Not all side effects are obvious. They can range from a skin rash, headache or upset stomach to changes in sleep, mood or other unexpected symptoms. Some side effects appear soon after starting a medicine; others may develop after prolonged use, a change in dose, taking several medicines together or even after treatment has stopped. If your medicine is making you feel worse, tell your doctor! Help make medicines safer for everyone! | World Health Organization (WHO)
